description: Large four-source AABB manifest map for V10 streaming alignment probes. The files are the existing V9 angle>=60 manifests; this map avoids copying large jsonl files.
notes: All four source manifests are already filtered toward large view changes, angle>=60.
The V10 alignment probe currently trains on AABB boundaries only.
AAAA and long/pattern manifests remain separate because this V10 probe uses oracle AABB boundaries.
